g.text: Steady Gaussian model with ground reflection, constant wind, assigned dispersion parameters, no deposition/decay, and flat terrain. H is effective height;
the drawing is schematic and does not set a plume-rise calculation. Sigma values are specified at500 m, not fitted to a stability curve. Ground centerline
value is for this section, not a global downwind maximum.
